summary_rationale: TD Power Systems has a credible specialized generator franchise, growing international OEM access, improving product breadth, a record of rising margins and low funded debt. The price-blind financial history is cyclical, with early losses and recent growth from a depressed base. FY2026 order momentum and expansion are strong, but customer concentration, long receivable and inventory cycles, CFO below PAT, high expansion capex, limited disclosure of product-level economics and the DF Power Systems subsidiary impairment constrain confidence in cash compounding. Capacity utilization, return on new investment and post-issue per-share growth need follow-through.
